inventory.digest_definition: SHA256 canonical sorted JSON of (private entry path, SHA256 canonical sorted node records); records include private relative path, type, mode, UID/GID, bytes, mtime/ctime ns, SHA256/Git blob OID for regular files. atime is excluded. Symlinks would use lstat target without traversal. Public nodes use anonymous IDs.

entries.role: Cython C intermediate with unconfirmed current producer
entries.creator: UNKNOWN

source_comparison.comparison_scope: Actual tracked candidates SHA256/index OID and per-source basename/duplicate/diff matrix retained privately. Public candidate IDs and summaries avoid raw paths. Basename-only collisions are not semantic counterpart diffs.

generation_and_runtime_source.creator_attribution: UNDETERMINED: UID/GID/mtime and generated headers do not identify the creating human or command

runtime_references.runtime_required_policy: Static next-launch/onroad consumers count as runtime dependencies even when no current open FD/mmap exists.

import_resolution.method: PathFinder.find_spec with explicit parent paths, never import vehicle/control/package initializers. Manager startup order inferred from observed cwd and PYTHONPATH plus matching interpreter standard paths; runtime sys.path changes remain unknown.
import_resolution.U32: Importable additional module, no same-basename tracked counterpart; no tracked static caller or current OS file reference observed. Current in-memory import status UNKNOWN.

recorder_patch.scope: All observed untracked node paths and audited static import roots. U48 changes dependency precedence but does not supply the recorder parent package. No assertion about arbitrary live dynamic import hooks.

route_inventory.definition: relative name, mode, byte size, mtime; no route content read for this digest

preservation.scope: Read-only observation window, not whole-device image attestation. Ordinary reads may update access times. No production writes or preservation restoration performed.
